name: Handing in a quest removes the surplus of its quest items, except where it is still useful (COA-10637)
contract: A quest-drop stack can leave more of a quest item in the bags than the quest asks for. At hand-in the whole lot of a quest-class item goes when nothing else needs it, even with an unrelated quest still in the log: Incendicite Ore 3340 (Search for Incendicite 466, 6 asked, 3 extra) leaves none, and so does Essence of the Elements 11129 for an orc handing in The Last Element 7201 (10 asked, 3 extra). It stays where it can still be used: Clara's Fresh Apple 8683 has an on-use spell (Items of Some Consequence 2746, 2 asked, 2 extra, 2 stay) and Essence of the Elements belongs to a repeatable quest that asks for it again (The Last Element 3911, 10 asked, 3 extra, 3 stay).

steps.label: SETUP: a keeps an unrelated quest in the log
SETUP: a holds the 6 asked and 3 extra Incendicite Ore
DISCRIMINATING: no Incendicite Ore is left after the hand-in
SETUP: a holds the 2 asked and 2 extra apples
CONTROL: the apples have an on-use spell, so the extra 2 stay
SETUP: a holds the 10 asked and 3 extra Essences of the Elements
CONTROL: The Last Element is repeatable, so the extra 3 stay for the next hand-in
SETUP: b holds the 10 asked and 3 extra Essences of the Elements
DISCRIMINATING: no Essence of the Elements is left after The Last Element is handed in
